description: Diagnose and fix React rendering, bundle, and data-loading performance using measurement first (React DevTools Profiler, Chrome Performance panel, bundle analysis) and modern React idioms (Suspense, transitions; React Compiler; and the React 19 features use(), Actions, useActionState, useOptimistic). Use when a React UI feels slow, INP/LCP regress, re-renders are excessive, lists lag, bundles are large, or someone proposes useMemo/useCallback/React.memo without evidence. Do not use for generic JS profiling outside React (use performance-profiling), CSS layout issues (web-html-css), or component API design (react-composition-patterns).
